narrative:
Guernsey County has 23,631 registered voters, with 15.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 29.4% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 50.1%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 20.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.6% of registrants.
